opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: The awards cover tuition fees only, up to a maximum of £1,820.

opportunities.summary: The scheme supports students enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education who are not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants

deadlines.raw: Applications will only be assessed after the closing date.

amount.raw: Students undertaking a two-year full-time Master’s programme may receive support for both years, funding is capped at a maximum of £5,000 per year.

opportunities.summary: The scheme helps graduates in Scotland meet the costs of postgraduate study.
